data.text:
Tigi Mathew vs Thiruvalla Muncipality on 10 May, 2024 
Author: Murali Purushothaman
Bench: Murali Purushothaman
Wp(C) No.17260/2024 1/3 Order Date : 10-0
 In The High Court Of Kerala At Ernakulam
 Present
 The Honourable Mr.Justice Murali Purushothaman
 Friday, the 10th day of May 2024 / 20th Vaisakha, 1946
 Wp(C) No. 17260 Of 2024
 Petitioner:
 Tigi Mathew, Aged 55 Years, S/O Chinnamma, Padinjarethu House,
 Muthoor P.O, Thiruvalla , Pathanamthitta District, Pin - 689107
 Respondents: 
 1. Thiruvalla Muncipality, Represented By It'S Secretary, Municipal
 Office, Thiruvalla, Pin-689101
 2. The Secretary, Thiruvalla Municipality, Municipal Office,
 Thiruvalla, Pin - 689101
 3. Jiju Mathew, Padinjarethu House, Muthoor P.O, Thiruvalla ,
 Pathanamthitta , Pin - 689107 
 Writ Petition (Civil) praying inter alia that in the  circumstances stated in the affidavit filed along with the WP(C)
 the High Court be pleased to direct 2nd respondent to allow the  petitioner to continue business pertaining to Ext P2 licence,
 pending disposal of this writ petition. 
 This petition coming on for orders upon perusing the  petition and the affidavit filed in support of WP(C) and upon  hearing the arguments of M/S. T.P.PRADEEP, P.K.SATHEES KUMAR,
 R.K.PRASANTH, MINIKUMARY M.V. & JIJO JOSEPH, Advocates for the  petitioner, the court passed the following:
 WP(C) No.17260/2024 2/3 Order Date : 10-  MURALI PURUSHOTHAMAN, J.
 ---------------------------------------------
 W.P (C) No.17260 of 2024  -------------------------------------------------
 Dated this the 10th day of May, 2024 Tigi Mathew vs Thiruvalla Muncipality on 10 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/25631555/
1  ORDER Admit.
2. Learned Standing Counsel takes notice for respondents 1 and 2. Issue notice to the 3 rd respondent by speed post. 
There shall not be any coercive proceedings against the petitioner for the reason that he has not produced the consent letter of the land lord. 
Sd/-
MURALI PURUSHOTHAMAN JUDGE akv WP(C) No.17260/2024 3/3 Order Date : 10-05-2024 APPENDIX OF WP(C) 17260/2024 Exhibit P1 TRUE COPY OF THE LICENCE DATED 02.04.2016 ISSUED BY THE ASSISTANT COMMISSIONER OF FOOD SAFETY , PATHANAMTHITTA DISTRICT Exhibit P2 TRUE COPY OF THE LICENCE DATED 16.11.2022 ISSUED BY THE 2ND RESPONDENT Exhibit P3 TRUE COPY OF THE INJUNCTION ORDER DATED 23.12.2023 IN IA 1/23 IN OS NO. 401/2023 ON THE FILES OF MUNSIFF COURT, THIRUVALLA Exhibit P4 TRUE COPY OF THE COMMUNICATION DATED 9.04.2024 ISSUED BY THE CLEAN CITY MANAGER Tigi Mathew vs Thiruvalla Muncipality on 10 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/25631555/
